about: Sound design plan for the V7 film (founder voice = master clock). The score and SFX in the review cut are synthesized in-project (scripts/make-score-v7.py, scripts/make-sfx-v7.py); ElevenLabs-generated replacements drop into the final/ slots.
rules: The founder's voice always wins: about 12–13 LU above the music under normal speech, about 15–16 LU under the key lines.
Music ducks −6 dB under every spoken line and −11 dB under the key lines (attack 0.15 s, release 0.6 s); it rises naturally in the pauses; it never disappears under speech.
SFX are felt, never louder than the voice; important interactions may peak briefly above the music; no whoosh on ordinary moves; no booms.
Controlled breaths, not dead silence: before 'Navis', 'A person decides.', Approve, the refusal; near-silence after 'NavisLabs.'; silence at the end.
Master: −14 LUFS integrated, ≤ −1 dBTP, no clipping.

scenes.music: M1 problem: low atmosphere, scattered fragments, heavier on 'by hand'
sfx: SOURCE APPEAR: the person's view, the agent's view; quieter ticks as the truth lands in each system
UI CLICK ×3 as fragments are copied by hand
scenes.silence: the pause after 'different truths' keeps only the atmosphere; a breath before 'Navis'

scenes.music: M2 reveal: the music opens on 'Navis'
sfx: PRODUCT REVEAL: a low bloom as 'Navis' lands on the mark
TRANSITION: soft air on the wipe into the light world
DATA ARRIVAL per signal
CONTEXT RETRIEVAL as memory becomes context
scenes.reason: All the scattered pieces become one.

sfx: UI CLICK on Why / Review & reply / Review draft / the sentence
SOURCE APPEAR per evidence row
KEYBOARD under the person's own sentence
APPROVE · SEND · GMAIL CONFIRM
scenes.silence: 'A person decides.' — the music drops back to a breath; a held breath on Approve; returns on 'Then the company acts.'
scenes.reason: Navis prepares. A person decides. The company acts.

sfx: KEYBOARD + TERMINAL
UI CLICK Add member
MCP CONNECT on ✓ Connected; tiny accents as MCP · API · SDK · CLI light
CONTEXT RETRIEVAL on the tool call; DATA ARRIVAL as each fact lands
API RESPONSE
PERMISSION DENIED: a low, serious tone
RUN START · RUN COMPLETE
scenes.silence: the rhythm thins under 'Navis isn't the model.' and stops for the permission check

scenes.music: M5 scale: one voice → the ensemble
sfx: UI CLICK 'For myself'
TERMINAL Enter + checkpoint recorded
CONTEXT RETRIEVAL as the next session restores
TRANSITION as the event reaches both products
scenes.silence: no SFX under 'Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.' — the voice carries it
scenes.reason: Solo, team, company: the same understanding.

sfx: END REVEAL on the end lockup
scenes.silence: near-silence after 'NavisLabs.'; a soft harmonic tail under the tagline; silent end
